hero.title: The front desk is busy. New patients still get booked.
hero.lead: Your AI receptionist answers the calls your team can't, texts back anyone who hangs up, and books new-patient and urgent visits into your calendar. It collects only a name, a phone number and a general reason for the visit.

missed_steps.title: It answers
missed_steps.text: Overflow and after-hours calls forward to your AI line. It answers with your practice name. Hang-ups get a text back within a minute.

missed_steps.title: It keeps it simple
missed_steps.text: New or existing patient, a general reason, a preferred time. No medical advice and no health history. Severe symptoms get a 911 instruction first.

missed_steps.title: It books, your team gets a text
missed_steps.text: Only the slots you open for new patients and urgent visits. Your team confirms details at the visit, as usual.

faq.q: Does it handle patient health information?
faq.a: No. It collects only a name, a phone number, new or existing patient, and a general reason such as "cleaning" or "tooth pain". It doesn't give medical advice. We don't sign a HIPAA BAA in this version, which is one reason this is early access.

faq.q: Does it connect to Dentrix or Open Dental?
faq.a: Not as a standard feature. Booking goes into Google Calendar or Calendly, and your team copies it into your practice system. A direct connection gets a custom quote.
After a legal review for dental practices. Early-access practices hear from us first, by email.

included_items: 1 AI line (a US number we provision; you keep your number and forward overflow and after-hours calls to it)
Answers missed and forwarded calls, plus a text-back to callers who hang up
Collects only a name, a phone number, new or existing patient, and a general reason for the visit
Booking new-patient and urgent visits into Google Calendar or Calendly, in the slots you open
Up to 25 FAQ entries (hours, location, insurance accepted), after-hours mode, and a 911 instruction for severe symptoms
Front-desk alerts by SMS and email for every booking, plus a daily summary email
A2P 10DLC SMS registration handled by us (registration fees included)
No medical advice, no health history, no patient records
